deflect.doc: The plasma sword's deflect mark (view only; DeflectMarks via CombatArena.deflected, FxView). On the bat frame: a cream starburst edged in ink, burst_m across, for flash_ticks; and a cream streak running streak_m along the returned round, fading over streak_ticks, so the round reads as sent back by the swing. flash_ticks 0 = none; --feel=off hides it too.

doc: Lane n7-melee: view-only marks of Rivet's melee that are not a camera effect (those are hit_feel.json rows). Metres and 60 Hz ticks.

saw.doc: The chainsaw kill made to read at 32 px/m (the audit rank 5: the held cop was a red blob under the saw). KillSplitFx, view only. clear_m: the grind's blood drops are hidden until they have flown this far from the bite, so the held body stays readable and the spray reads as leaving it (0 = the drops print over the body, the before). shake_m: the held body's judder (0.035 = the before, about 1 px at 32 px/m). release_m: on the frame the halves part, a cream starburst edged in ink this wide (the kill frame; a slash along the cut hid on the saw bar), shrinking over 12 ticks (0 = none). --feel=off = the before values.
